::: {.why}
The canon is small and the failure is speed rather than knowledge, so from here the sessions are timed and the score is the deliverable.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Solve eight conditional probability problems under a clock and score yourself honestly.
- For every problem you missed, name the technique you failed to reach for rather than the answer you got wrong.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [40 min]{.task-min} Forty minutes, eight problems, five minutes each, no notes, out loud where you can. Stop at the time limit whether or not you are finished, because running over is the habit that costs you in a real interview.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Review only the misses, and write the technique rather than the solution: natural frequencies instead of Bayes, conditioning on the first step, complementary counting, or drawing the sample space. The technique list is short and it is what transfers.
:::
:::

::: {.deliverable}
A scored eight-problem session with a technique named for every miss.
:::

## Checkpoint

::: {.checkpoint}
You are told at least one of two children is a boy. Probability both are boys, and why is the answer not one half?
:::
